verdict.rationale: Reclaim's core design is autonomous background calendar automation. Users configure Habits, Focus Time goals, Tasks, buffers, travel time and Calendar Sync. The system then schedules and reschedules events on its own when conflicts arise, keeps synced copies updated, and syncs Slack status without manual intervention. Community users confirm the bot proactively adds items and 'stays completely out of the way.' Missing for 10: a general user-defined automation builder (custom triggers and actions beyond preset features and hashtag rules), any API or programmatic way to define automations, and more extensive independent hands-on corroboration.
